messages.subject: strange behavior with shiny update
parts:
It seems that each time I update shiny, I get new strange behavior that is quite difficult figure out.  This time, I cannot figure it out.  To illustrate, consider a slightly modified example (example "02_text" with the change that the header title is the name of the currently selected dataset):

server.R:

library(shiny)
library(datasets)

# Define server logic required to summarize and view the selected dataset
shinyServer(function(input, output) {

  # Return the requested dataset
  datasetInput <- reactive({
    switch(input$dataset,
           "rock" = rock,
           "pressure" = pressure,
           "cars" = cars)
  })

  # Generate a summary of the dataset
  output$summary <- renderPrint({
    dataset <- datasetInput()
    summary(dataset)
  })

  output$title <- renderText({
     input$dataset
  })

  # Show the first "n" observations
  output$view <- renderTable({
    head(datasetInput(), n = input$obs)
  })
})


ui.R:

library(shiny)

# Define UI for dataset viewer application
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(

  # Application title
  headerPanel(
    htmlOutput("title")
  ),

  # Sidebar with controls to select a dataset and specify the number
  # of observations to view
  sidebarPanel(
    selectInput("dataset", "Choose a dataset:", 
                choices = c("rock", "pressure", "cars")),

    numericInput("obs", "Number of observations to view:", 10)
  ),

  # Show a summary of the dataset and an HTML table with the requested
  # number of observations
  mainPanel(
    verbatimTextOutput("summary"),

    tableOutput("view")
  )
))


Now, replace headerPanel with the following (putting it all in a bootstrap navbar):

  headerPanel(
    div(class='navbar navbar-fixed-top',
      div(class='navbar-inner',
        div(class='container-fluid',
          div(class='span3',
            tags$a(class='brand', htmlOutput("title"))
          )
        )
      )
    )  
  )

Notice that now there is no output.  In the DOM, I do get the following:
<div id="title" class="shiny-html-output shiny-bound-output"></div>
But it is not really bound.  You might think that this is because of a htmlOutput being embedded in a tag, or something similar.  However, simply removing the class of the first div brings reactivity back.

  headerPanel(
    div(
      div(class='navbar-inner',
        div(class='container-fluid',
          div(class='span3',
            tags$a(class='brand', htmlOutput("title"))
          )
        )
      )
    )  
  )

This worked fine with the previous version of shiny.  Any idea on what the problem is here?

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: strange behavior with shiny update
parts:
I think you're right that being hidden is source of the issue.

The hidden detection code is simple: if an object has zero width and zero height, then Shiny thinks it's hidden:
  https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/blob/master/inst/www/shared/shiny.js#L1518

If you run options(shiny.trace=TRUE), you'll see this output with your app:
RECV {"method":"init","data":{"dataset":"rock","obs:number":10,".shinyout_title_hidden":true,".shinyout_summary_hidden":false,".shinyout_view_hidden":false,"__allowDataUriScheme":true}}

My guess is that what's happening is that the initial size of the object is 0x0 pixels, and so output$title is never run. You can force objects to not suspend by putting this in your shinyServer call:
    outputOptions(output, 'title', suspendWhenHidden=FALSE)


But the appearance isn't quite right -- the nav bar overlaps the other stuff and looks like it doesn't really want to be that size. Is that how you want it to appear?
